title: Spicy Jalebi Fritters
description: A twist on traditional Indian street food, these crispy fritters are filled with a spicy jalebi flavor. Serve with a side of tangy tomato chutney.
instructions: Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, mix together jalebi, lush, tomato, and Indian spices.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot with tomato chutney.
Repeat with remaining mixture, adjusting the heat as needed.
